::: {.ref-description}
This component removes observations or features that fall outside specified quantile ranges in .obs or .var. columns.

For example, you can filter out observations with total UMI counts in the bottom 5% (quantile < 0.05) or
top 5% (quantile > 0.95), or retain an intermediate range (0.1 < quantile < 0.9).
:::

::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_log1p_transform`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Apply log1p transformation to the obs_column values before calculating quantiles.
The transformed values will be stored as 'log1p_{obs_column}' in .obs.
This is useful for highly skewed data where log transformation can improve quantile-based filtering.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_min_quantile`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Minimum quantile threshold for .obs filtering. Observations with values below this quantile will be removed.
Value should be between 0.0 and 1.0.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Example]{.arg-key} `0.05`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Max]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}

::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/filter/filter_with_quantile/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/filter/filter_with_quantile);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/filter/filter_with_quantile/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
